proof_summary: Introduce two auxiliary sequences, both satisfying \(u_{k+2}=112u_{k+1}-4096u_k\), with initial values chosen so that the first odd terms are their squares; linear relations between the two sequences yield squared recurrences matching the derived stride-two recurrence \(a_{n+6}=-48a_{n+4}+3072a_{n+2}+262144a_n\). Induction over a three-term window then proves \(a_{4k+1}=y_k^2\) and \(a_{4k+3}=z_k^2\), which covers every odd index.
